		function trackTwitter(intent_event) {
			if (intent_event) {
				var opt_pagePath;
				if (intent_event.target && intent_event.target.nodeName == 'IFRAME') {
					opt_target = extractParamFromUri(intent_event.target.src, 'url');

			}
		}
		
		function extractParamFromUri(uri, paramName) {
			if (!uri) return;
			
			var regex = new RegExp('[\\?&#]' + paramName + '=([^&#]*)');
			var params = regex.exec(uri);
			if (params != null) return unescape(params[1]);
			return;
		}
		
		// Wrap event bindings - Wait for async js to load
		twttr.ready(function (twttr) {
			//event bindings
			twttr.events.bind('tweet', trackTwitter);
		});

					clearTimeout(slideTimer);
					slideTimer = setTimeout("slideshow_change(500);", msDelay);

				function slideshow_change(fadeTime) {
					if(!slideTransition) {
						// next
						var nextIndex = activeIndex + 1;
						if(nextIndex >= slideCount) nextIndex = 0;
						if(!homeSlides[nextIndex].loaded) nextIndex = 0;
						slideshow_nav(nextIndex, fadeTime);
					}
				}

				function slideshow_nav(newIndex, fadeTime) {
					if(!slideTransition) {
						if(newIndex != activeIndex) {
							clearTimeout(slideTimer);
							slideTransition = true;
							if(newIndex < activeIndex) {
								$(homeSlides[newIndex].slide).fadeIn(fadeTime, function() {		 
									// Animation complete.
									if(activeIndex != (slideCount-1)) $(homeSlides[activeIndex].slide).fadeOut(0);
									// update nav dots
									$("#slideshow_navButton_" + activeIndex).removeClass("navOn");
									$("#slideshow_navButton_" + newIndex).addClass('navOn');
									activeIndex = newIndex;
									activeIndex = newIndex;
									// finish up
									slideTransition = false;
									slideshow_setTimer(slideTimeDelay);
								});
							} else {
								if(activeIndex != (slideCount-1)) $(homeSlides[newIndex].slide).fadeIn(0);
								$(homeSlides[activeIndex].slide).fadeOut(fadeTime, function() {		 
									// Animation complete.
									// update nav dots
									$("#slideshow_navButton_" + activeIndex).removeClass("navOn");
									$("#slideshow_navButton_" + newIndex).addClass('navOn');
									activeIndex = newIndex;
									activeIndex = newIndex;
									// finish up
									slideTransition = false;
									slideshow_setTimer(slideTimeDelay);
								});
							}
						}
					}
				}
			
				$(document).ready(function() {
					if(slideCount > 1) {
						$('#homeSlideshow .slide').each(function(i, thisSlide) {

						});
						$(window).load(function () { nextLoad(); });
					}
				});
